title: Anaesthesia related outcomes of children with congenital heart disease undergoing surgical or nonsurgical cardiac procedures: a multicenter, observational trial
summary: Children with congenital heart defects represent a special patient group, as they often require cardiac surgery or interventional procedures in the cardiac catheterization laboratory during their first years of life. Despite the high incidence and the large number of specialized centers in Germany, there is currently a lack of prospective multicenter data on anesthesia-related outcomes in this population. The aim of this study is to record anesthesia-related complications in children with congenital heart defects who undergo cardiac surgery or cardiac catheterization.

interventions.name: A multicenter, prospective observational study is planned to address various current questions regarding anesthesia-related outcome parameters in children with congenital heart defects who undergo either cardiac surgery or a cardiac catheterization/intervention under anesthesia care. Inclusion criteria:
All children and adolescents undergoing anesthesia for surgical or interventional cardiac procedures will be included. The data consists of routine care data that is entered into the database in pseudononymized form.
Exclusion criteria:
Age 18 years or older.
